remarks: Welcome to 15 Edmund Street in Cheektowaga, NY! Pride of ownership shines throughout this beautifully maintained, all-brick ranch offering 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and an impressive combination of updates, comfort, and additional living space! Step inside to discover gleaming hardwood floors, neutral décor, and an inviting layout. The updated kitchen features beautiful solid-surface countertops, newer cabinetry, and appliances, while the main bathroom boasts a Bath Fitter update completed approximately 3 years ago. The finished basement adds approximately 900 square feet of versatile bonus space, complete with a cozy gas fireplace, second kitchen, full bathroom, and dedicated office area—perfect for entertaining, hobbies, or everyday living. Another standout feature is the Patio Enclosures sunroom with an electric fireplace, providing a wonderful retreat to enjoy throughout the seasons! Major improvements include a 2-year-old architectural roof, replacement windows within the past 10 years, updated electrical, and a furnace and central air system that have been professionally maintained annually. Additional features include a backup sump pump and a bubbler system installed approximately 4 years ago. The exterior is equally impressive, featuring a stamped concrete walkway leading to the welcoming covered front porch, a concrete driveway, and a spacious 2.5-car detached garage. Enjoy outdoor gatherings on the patio with a designated grilling area, while the deep backyard extends beyond the garage, offering even more outdoor space to enjoy. Meticulously cared for inside and out, this wonderful ranch offers the perfect blend of timeless brick construction, thoughtful updates, and flexible living spaces. Showings begin at the open house Wednesday 10/21 from 5pm to 7pm. Additional open house Saturday 10/24 from 1pm to 3pm. Offers to be submitted Tuesday, 10/27 by 12pm.
